marco_sales: Quick askProspect StoneRiver wants a BYO-KEK POC for PII. Requirements: HSM-kept KEK, monthly rotation, dual-custody, and an attestation bundle for auditors. They also want a simple cost delta: per-HSM-call vs included in Dedicated. Who can lead?

anya_se: I can run. Need their HSM endpoints (IPs/ports), FIPS level, and whether dual-custody == split-threshold or two-key holders. Also need expected QPS to estimate cost.

lina_eng: Note on perf: direct HSM calls on hot path add ~40-70ms p99. Options: local key-proxy (reduces HSM egress but adds infra/audit surface) or only hit HSM at rotation. Ask QPS.

david_security: For legal: vendor + firmware, attestation format (signed manifest vs vendor statement), audit retention requirements, and a signed no-export statement. Fallback to platform KEK during outages requires explicit opt-in in SOW.

marco_sales: Action items: 1) ask StoneRiver for HSM connection details + attestation spec and QPS, 2) ops open a POC ticket, 3) we prepare a short pricing delta table.

ops_bot: Ticket created: POC-1810 "StoneRiver BYO-KEK POC" assigned to @anya_se. ETA runbook draft 2025-03-22. Link: https://redwood.example.com/t/POC-1810

anya_se: Proposed minimal tests: wrap->unwrap with provided KEK alias, verify bilateral audit logs, simulate monthly rotation and test 30m fallback to platform KEK, and measure latency with/without proxy.

marco_sales: I'll ping StoneRiver legal and devs for the details. Thanks all :thumbsup:
